name: FabFilter Pro-Q 4
shortDescription: The latest version of FabFilter's acclaimed parametric equalizer with improved mid/side processing, dynamic EQ bands, and real-time frequency collision detection.
longDescription: FabFilter Pro-Q 4 builds on the legacy of one of the most trusted EQs in professional audio production. New: enhanced dynamic EQ with sidechain support, improved high-resolution spectrum display, natural phase mode, and up to 96 bands of precision EQ. Available as VST3, AU, AAX and CLAP.

name: Surge XT 2.3
shortDescription: Free and open-source hybrid synthesizer with expanded modulation matrix, new oscillator algorithms, and improved CLAP plugin support. One of the most feature-rich free synths available.
longDescription: Surge XT continues rapid development with version 2.3 adding new oscillator types, an expanded modulation matrix, improved MPE support, and full CLAP compatibility. Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
targetAudience: Sound designers and electronic music producers

name: Valhalla Supermassive 2
shortDescription: Updated version of Valhalla's massively popular free reverb and delay plugin. New: four additional algorithms, improved low-CPU mode, and resizable UI up to 200%.
longDescription: Valhalla Supermassive 2 adds four brand-new reverb/delay algorithms to an already staggering collection, plus a redesigned GUI that scales cleanly on high-DPI displays. Still completely free.

name: iZotope Ozone 12
shortDescription: AI-assisted mastering suite with new Master Rebalance stem controls, improved Imager, and a redesigned Master Assistant that adapts to your reference track in real time.
longDescription: Ozone 12 brings iZotope's most advanced AI mastering tools with a new stem-aware Master Rebalance module, improved low-end focus, and a streamlined workflow from mix to release.
targetAudience: Mastering engineers and producers finishing tracks

name: Arturia Pigments 5
shortDescription: Arturia's flagship software synthesizer gains a new Harmonic engine, improved arpeggiator/sequencer, and deeper modulation routing with up to 16 modulation slots per patch.
longDescription: Pigments 5 adds a brand-new Harmonic oscillator engine alongside wavetable, virtual analog, sample, and granular synthesis. The updated sequencer supports per-step probability and polyrhythmic patterns.
targetAudience: Sound designers and electronic music producers

name: Baby Audio Transit
shortDescription: Automation-friendly transition plugin that controls up to 12 effects simultaneously via a single macro — stutter, pitch rise, filter sweep, reverb swell all at once.
longDescription: Transit is Baby Audio's answer to cluttered transition workflows: one macro controls up to 12 effects simultaneously, automatable over any bar length. Perfect for EDM, hip-hop, and cinematic productions.
pros: Sounds great out of the box

name: Kilohearts Phase Plant 2
shortDescription: Modular synthesizer plugin with reworked visual routing, a new LFO editor, drag-and-drop module slots, and a redesigned effects lane. Now with 1000+ factory presets.
longDescription: Phase Plant 2 overhauls the UI while keeping the beloved modular architecture. New features include improved connection system, redesigned oscilloscope, CLAP support, and a library of 1000+ factory presets.
targetAudience: Advanced synthesizer users and sound designers

name: Oeksound Bloom
shortDescription: Spectral transient and dynamics processor from the makers of Soothe2. Tracks and shapes attack and sustain of individual frequency bands independently.
longDescription: Following Soothe2, Oeksound's Bloom brings spectral-aware processing to transient shaping. Each frequency band has independent attack and sustain treatment — great for drums and complex mixes.

name: Infiltrator 2
shortDescription: Multi-effects sequencer updated with 12 new effect modules including granular processing, improved MIDI learn, and a randomize function for instant creative variation.
longDescription: Infiltrator 2 chains up to two parallel banks of 10 effects, all synced to your DAW's tempo. Version 2 adds vocal effects, granular processing, and an overhauled preset browser with 500+ new patches.
cons: Can be CPU heavy with many modules

name: LABS Free Piano 2
shortDescription: Spitfire's beloved free piano library updated with new mic perspectives, expanded dynamic layers, and compatibility with the latest LABS player including convolution reverb.
longDescription: LABS Free Piano 2 provides a new collection of intimate acoustic piano tones recorded at Abbey Road Studios. The updated LABS player adds convolution reverb and improved velocity mapping.
targetAudience: Composers and producers needing quality piano
